issue.title: Update contributing guidelines
issue.body:
Goal: get more high quality contributions

Current contributing guidelines are great. I would like to include a list tickets that potential contributors can work on. This requires vetting the tickets and scoping them so they are ready to be worked on by external contributors.

This ticket is a placeholder, more details to be added when one starts working on it. Assigning myself so that I have it on my radar. Reassign to yourself if you want to take it on!
